sys_remote_update_set.description:
Contender Solutions Enhancement Pack - Discovery - Cisco LWAP and controllers. © 2016 Contender Solutions LLC. Author: Derek Page (dpage@contendersolutions.com) Date: 1/11/2016
This enhancement pack adds functionality for discovering Cisco WAP controllers and their connected AP's. Cisco WAP controllers must be discovered via the SNMP sysObjectID, as ServiceNow discovery provides no mechanism for classifying them as WAP controllers based on general MIB-2 data (as of Fuji). This enhancement pack ships with several defined sysObjectID classifiers for devices known to be WAP controllers. If additional models are needed they can easily be added to the SNMP System OID's list.

	process: function(result) {	
		this.ciData = new CIData();

		this.analyze(snmp, capabilities, props);

	analyze: function(snmp, capabilities, props) {
		//current date is latest discovery date.
		var lastDiscoDate = new GlideDateTime();
		
        //get the parent WAP Controller CI 
        var controller = new GlideRecord("u_cmdb_ci_wap_controller");
		controller.addQuery("u_active", true);
		controller.addQuery("ip_address", snmp.snmp['@ip']);
		controller.query();
		//if not found then quit.  This should already exist since we're in exploration phase.
		if (!controller.next()) {
			//log that the CI wasn't found and return.
			this.handleError([("Unable to find the CI for the WAP Controller at IP " + snmp.snmp['@ip'])]);
			return;
		}
		
		//relationship type created between WAP controller and WAP's
		var relTypeName = "Connects to::Connected by";
		
		//keep track of all WAP's created or updated on this run.  We will use this later to dissociate any existing WAP to controller
		//associations which are no longer valid (might happen if a WAP is decomissioned or moved to a different controller(s)
		var currentWAPList = [];
		
		//get all the WAP devices from the SNMP table
        var devices = snmp.getOIDTable("iso.org.dod.internet.private.enterprises.cisco.ciscoMgmt.ciscoLwappApMIB.ciscoLwappApMIBObjects.ciscoLwappAp", 'cLApEntry');       
        for (var index in devices) {
			
			//get current device data.
            var device = devices[index];
			
			//MAC is our unique key for WAP's so if we don't have this info then we can't create a CI for it
			if (JSUtil.notNil(device["cLApIfMacAddress"])) {
			
				//try to find an existing CI.
				var wap = new GlideRecord("u_cmdb_ci_wap");
				wap.addQuery("u_active", true);			
				wap.addQuery("mac_address", device["cLApIfMacAddress"]);
				wap.query();
				
				//if we found existing CI(s)
				if (wap.next()) {
					
					//if we find more than one then we can't proceed.
					if (wap.getRowCount() > 1) {
						this.handleError([("Non-unique CI match.  Found " + wap.getRowCount() + " ACTIVE WAP CI's for MAC: " + device["cLApIfMacAddress"])]);
						continue;  //done for this device.
					}
					
				//else if we don't find it then create it
				} else {
					wap = new GlideRecord("u_cmdb_ci_wap");
					wap.initialize();
					//have to set MAC address on insert.
					wap.mac_address = device["cLApIfMacAddress"];
					wap.insert();
				}			
				
				//the following data points are updated everytime the WAP is discovered.			
				wap.name = device["cLApName"];			
				wap.last_discovered = lastDiscoDate;
				wap.discovery_source = "ServiceNow";
				wap.location = controller.location;
				wap.update();
				
				//add this WAP to the current list
				currentWAPList.push("" + wap.sys_id);
				
				//check for a relationship between this WAP and the controller we found it on.
				var parentCI = wap.sys_id;
				var childCI = controller.sys_id;
				
				var rel = new GlideRecord("cmdb_rel_ci");
				rel.addQuery("parent", parentCI);
				rel.addQuery("type.name", relTypeName);
				rel.addQuery("child", childCI);
				rel.query();
				//if no existing relationship then add one.
				if (!rel.hasNext()) {
					rel = new GlideRecord("cmdb_rel_ci");
					rel.initialize();
					rel.parent = parentCI;
					rel.setDisplayValue("type", relTypeName);
					rel.child = childCI;
					rel.insert();
				}
			}
        }
		
		//finally, let's remove any WAP to controller associations which are no longer valid.
		if (currentWAPList.length > 0) {
			
			//search for any relationships to the current controller and WAP's that are NOT in the list of ones we just found			
			var existingRel = new GlideRecord("cmdb_rel_ci");
			existingRel.addQuery("child", controller.sys_id);
			existingRel.addQuery("type.name", relTypeName);			
			//add all WAP sys_id's			
			for (var i = 0; i < currentWAPList.length; i++) {
				existingRel.addQuery("parent", "!=", currentWAPList[i]);
			}			
			existingRel.query();
			existingRel.deleteMultiple();
		}
    },
    
    type: 'DiscoverySensor'
